$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. Project per FB-RAT-WS-001 (Workspace Kernel is authoritative for projects). Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<Project> (see schemas/common/envelope.schema.json); `projectId` below is this object's own FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID. `resourceUri`'s ResourceUri shape ($defs below) mirrors resource-uri.schema.json — duplicated locally rather than cross-file $ref'd, same standalone-file tradeoff COMMON_CONVENTIONS.md documents for IntegrityRef; the two copies MUST be kept in sync by hand.
title: Project

projectId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this project (FB-RAT-COM-002), independent of `displayName` or `rootUri` — moving or renaming a project's root MUST NOT change this.

workspaceId.description: The owning `Workspace.workspaceId` (FB-RAT-WS-001). A Project MUST belong to exactly one Workspace.

displayName.description: Human-legible project name. Display-only; never an identity key.

repositoryStateId.description: Stable ID of this project's RepositoryState, when the project's root is a git-tracked working tree. Null for a project that is not (yet) git-tracked. RepositoryState's full shape is documented in WORKSPACE_KERNEL_SPEC.md §5 (no standalone repository-state.schema.json in this work package — see that document's scope note) rather than schema-validated here; this field is only the forward-pointing stable-ID link.

taskDefinitionIds.description: Stable `TaskDefinition.taskDefinitionId` values scoped to this project (FB-RAT-WS-001 — the kernel is authoritative for tasks). TaskDefinition's full shape is documented in WORKSPACE_KERNEL_SPEC.md §5, not schema-validated in this work package.

languageSessionIds.description: Stable `LanguageSession.languageSessionId` values currently active for this project (FB-RAT-WS-001 — the kernel is authoritative for language sessions). LanguageSession's full shape is documented in WORKSPACE_KERNEL_SPEC.md §5, not schema-validated in this work package.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).
